def solve(inp):
    Hh,Ww=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    objs=comps(inp)
    # draw order: ascending TL (top-left-most object first, anchored at grid corner)
    objs.sort(key=lambda o:min(max(r for r,_ in o[1]), max(c for _,c in o[1])))
    g=[[0]*Ww for _ in range(Hh)]
    for col,cells in objs:
        cur=set(cells)
        while True:
            tgt={(r-1,c-1) for r,c in cur}
            if any(not(0<=r<Hh and 0<=c<Ww) or g[r][c]!=0 for r,c in tgt): break
            cur=tgt
        for r,c in sorted(cur): g[r][c]=col
    return g

def solve(inp, kk):
    Hh,Ww=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    objs=comps(inp)
    objs.sort(key=keys[kk], reverse=True)

            cur=tgt
        for r,c in sorted(cur): g[r][c]=col
    return g
